title: PetaCraft
description: There is no logic, it is just content
body:
**General Content:**

This mod adds a wide variety of items, blocks, entities, and some new biomes. The mod itself doesn't follow a general logic, since you can find everything: Ender Torches, Coal made from bushes, Living Lemons, and even PVZ's Cherrybombs, you can find anything in this place.

**Credits:**

Actually most of the textures of items, blocks, entities and other things were not made by me, so in the art part, although I don't know all the creators in general, if you know who they are, give them credit. Including the items and blocks that are based on other games or directly extracted from them.

I also want to credit MCreator for being the tool I used to create this mod.

 

Credits that I have been able to collect:
-Original creators of Plants Vs Zombies
-StitchYYT from Redit for some block and mineral textures I found
-EndoEnnard1 also from Redit for textures of other blocks and items I have made
-ARoachIFoundOnMyPillow from OpenGameArt for some pixel art sprites I've used [mainly vegetation]

--Common-Tea-6511 For textures of minerals, ingots and other gold
-Terraria for some ingots and sprites I took

The rest from what I have seen are free to use or I have made them myself

 

**Languages:**

English and Spanish... not one or the other, both... I don't really know why I did this, but you can see parts of English in some items and blocks, and parts of Spanish in others. Both for work reasons and for laziness...

**Warnings:**

This mod is not going to have support, neither for bugs nor errors, it was a quick creation that I made just to play with friends, but I decided to publish it in case someone wanted to play this. I will probably make a ChangeLog that tells the changes between updates, but it is not my main mod, it is rather one just for fun that you can also play.

**Dependencies:**

This mod does not include any dependencies, it will only be available for 1.16.5 and that's it, you don't need any other mod to play it [If there are any future exceptions, I will let you know here]

I was publishing this mod on CurseForge, so I probably forgot to update it here lol, sorry for the inconvenience, but if I remember then I will continue posting updates here
